## Details

<a id="title_tune_voice2"></a>
### [`title_tune_voice2`](../../../../src/data/title_tune_notes.asm#L6) `$5FE8`

*data*

128 note pairs of the title tune: voice 2, then voice 1. Each note is an index in the frequency table at $8303. The set-up also copies these 256 bytes to $3000, the characters $00-$1f of the cave character set.

- **Read by:** [`play_title_tune`](../sound/title_tune.md#play_title_tune), [`init_screens`](../init/init_screens.md#init_screens)
